# What does one mug really cost you, and what should it sell for?

> Free pottery pricing calculator. Clay, glaze, kiln firing cost, breakage, your hours and studio rent in; true cost per sellable piece, the retail and wholesale price for your target margin and your hourly return out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/pottery-piece-pricing-calculator/)
